mapper.select: SELECT toString(ref_sample.stable_id) AS reference_sample_id, toString(portal_sample.stable_id) AS sample_id, part.part_key AS part_key, part.part_number AS part_number, part.part_designator AS part_designator, part.part_type AS part_type, part.part_description AS part_description, part.subspecialty AS subspecialty, part.path_dx_title AS path_dx_title, block.block_key AS block_key, block.block_number AS block_number, block.block_label AS block_label, slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.stain_name AS stain_name, slide.stain_group AS stain_group, slide.is_hne AS is_hne, slide.is_ihc AS is_ihc, slide.magnification AS magnification, slide.file_size_bytes AS file_size_bytes, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.barcode AS barcode, slide.slide_type AS slide_type, placement.match_level AS match_level, placement.specimen_key AS specimen_key, timepoint.procedure_date_days AS procedure_date_days, timepoint.timepoint_source AS timepoint_source FROM ( SELECT * FROM wsi_patient PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) ps LEFT JOIN sample ref_sample ON ref_sample.internal_id = ps.reference_sample_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_part PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) part ON part.cancer_study_id = ps.cancer_study_id AND part.patient_id = ps.patient_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_block PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) block ON block.cancer_study_id = part.cancer_study_id AND block.patient_id = part.patient_id AND block.part_key = part.part_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide_placement PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) placement ON placement.cancer_study_id = block.cancer_study_id AND placement.patient_id = block.patient_id AND placement.part_key = block.part_key AND placement.block_key = block.block_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND slide.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND slide.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN sample portal_sample ON portal_sample.internal_id = placement.sample_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT event.patient_id AS patient_id, toNullable(event.start_date) AS procedure_date_days, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SAMPLE_ID'), '') AS sample_id, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SUBTYPE'), '') AS subtype, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'MATCH_LEVEL'), '') AS match_level, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'IMAGE_IDS'), '') AS image_ids, coalesce( nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SPECIMEN_KEY'), ''), nullIf( decodeURLComponent( extractURLParameter( maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'LINKOUT'), 'specimenKey' ) ), '' ) ) AS specimen_key, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'TIMEPOINT_SOURCE'), '') AS timepoint_source FROM clinical_event event INNER JOIN clinical_event_data data ON data.clinical_event_id = event.clinical_event_id WHERE event.patient_id = #{patientInternalId} AND upperUTF8(event.event_type) = 'PATHOLOGY SLIDES' GROUP BY event.clinical_event_id, event.patient_id, event.start_date ) timepoint ON timepoint.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND upperUTF8(timepoint.match_level) = placement.match_level AND timepoint.specimen_key = placement.specimen_key AND ( (timepoint.image_ids IS NOT NULL AND has(JSONExtract(timepoint.image_ids, 'Array(String)'), toString(slide.image_id))) OR timepoint.image_ids IS NULL ) AND upperUTF8(timepoint.sample_id) = upperUTF8( if(placement.sample_id IS NULL, 'Unmatched', toString(portal_sample.stable_id)) ) AND replaceAll(upperUTF8(timepoint.subtype), '&', '') = multiIf( slide.is_ihc, 'IHC', slide.is_hne, 'HE', 'OTHER' ) ORDER BY sample_id, part.part_key, block.block_key, slide.image_id
